title: CohortResolution
description: A frozen list of cases that match a Cohort's selection criteria at a point in time. Cohort holds intent; CohortResolution holds the snapshot. Multiple Resolutions over time are expected as new studies match the criteria; each Resolution is immutable once written. The 'latest' Resolution for a cohort is found by Mango/view query.

cohort_id.description: Reference to the Cohort this resolution snapshots.

resolved_at.description: When the resolution was produced (may differ from created_at if the resolver ran asynchronously).

resolver.description: Identifier of the agent or import process that produced this resolution. e.g. 'lnq-retro-import-v1' or 'cohort-resolver-agent-v0'.

cases.description: Frozen list of cases. Order is preserved (used for default worklist order).

case_id.description: Identifier of the case within this cohort. For DICOM cohorts, conventionally the StudyInstanceUID; for file-based cohorts, a project-local identifier like 'case_0042'.

study_uid.description: DICOM Study Instance UID when known.

series_uid.description: DICOM Series Instance UID when applicable.

primary_site.description: Anatomic / disease site label, drawn from clinical metadata. Free text.

ct_ref.description: Reference to the primary CT/MR/PT volume for this case.

metadata.description: Free-form per-case metadata: anything from the source CSV that doesn't fit the named fields above (training-case flag, tumour stage, scanner info, etc.).
